population: UK general consumers age 16 and over; n=4,000; statistically weighted by age, gender, region and socioeconomic status
recall_period: Usual leisure frequency, at least four times per week; no bounded recall
frequency_definition: Daily or nearly every day equals at least four times per week, printed p.5 footnote 11
question_wording: Exact questionnaire not published in this overview; the figure reports usual format engagement frequency.
format_scope: Print books, ebooks and audiobooks asked separately; reading by choice excludes work or education.
evidence_locator: Printed p.5 (PDF index 5), Figure 2, Daily or nearly every day column and footnote 11; methods printed pp.24 and 25 (PDF indices 24 and 25); base n=4,000 unless indicated otherwise on printed p.3 footnote 5.
